task:
We ran a [U-13C6]-glucose tracing experiment in cultured cells and harvested at 1, 4, 8 and 24 h (samples Glc13C_1h ... Glc13C_24h). A parallel culture grown on unlabelled glucose and harvested at 24 h (Glc12C_24h) is also included. Four metabolites were measured by MS: peak areas for each mass isotopologue (M0, M1, ... = ion mass shifted by 0, 1, ... x 1.00335 Da; NA = not measured) are in data/isotopologue_areas.tsv. data/metabolites.tsv gives, for each metabolite, the formula of the ion that was actually measured (this includes any derivatisation atoms retained in the fragment), backbone_carbons (the number of carbons that come from the metabolite itself, i.e. the only positions that tracer carbon can occupy), the tracer and tracer_13C_purity (atom fraction of 13C at each labelled position of the tracer). Peak areas are on arbitrary, sample-specific scales.

For each of the following metabolite x time-point combinations, report the fractional 13C enrichment attributable to the tracer: the mean number of tracer-derived carbon atoms per molecule divided by backbone_carbons, i.e. sum_i i*MID_i / n, where MID_i (i = 0..n, summing to 1) is the fraction of the metabolite pool carrying i tracer-derived carbons. Report it as a fraction between 0 and 1 (not a percentage), to 3 decimals.

lactate at 4 h; lactate at 24 h; alanine at 8 h; citrate at 8 h; glutamate at 4 h; glutamate at 24 h.

Return EXACTLY:

<EVAL_ANSWER>
{"lactate_4h": <number>, "lactate_24h": <number>, "alanine_8h": <number>, "citrate_8h": <number>, "glutamate_4h": <number>, "glutamate_24h": <number>}
</EVAL_ANSWER>
design_source: Raw MIDs include natural-abundance isotopes of every element in the measured ion (incl. derivative atoms) and tracer impurity; enrichment needs full correction (Buescher et al. 2015 Curr Opin Biotechnol; Midani et al. 2017).
